title: The Fort Closes and Chain Singh Urges Settlement

blocks.text: Once the Patiala line collapses, survivors scramble for the safety of the fort. The Fort gates did they shut behind the fugitives, while artillery thunders and surrounding villages suffer plunder in the wake of the Khalsa advance.

Victory, however, does not simply become indiscriminate destruction. Chain Singh and Dulcha Singh approach Baghel Singh to argue that the lesson has already been delivered and that a negotiated settlement will better preserve both honor and the wider unity of the Panth.

This page therefore turns the battle toward diplomacy. The Khalsa has shown its strength in the field, and now the question becomes how to translate that strength into terms that even defeated rivals must respect.
